2574 ká², nom. sg. m. káḥ, f. kā́, n. kím q.v., gen. sg. m.n. kásya, inst. kḗna. In nom. m.f. largely replaced by kaḥ punar and kō'paraḥ.
    Pa. Pk. kō m., kā f., gen. kassa, kissa with i from kim; Gy. pal. kē 'what?', arm. ke, eur. rum. kay 'where?' (hung. ko < kon see kaḥ punar); Ash. ċēi < ki- NTS xiii 233, obl. kō, Kt. Wg. kĭ̄; Dm. acc. kā̆s; Paš. kī; Kho. ka, obl. kos; Sv. kas; Mai. ky. kā̃, inst. kē̃; Woṭ. kā̃, obl. kas, inst. kĩ; Phal. kō, gen. kasī́; Sh. kō, f. kē; K. kus, ko in kozana 'who knows?'; S. ko, f. kā; P. ko 'someone'; WPah. obl. bhad. kas, bhal. kis; Ku. ko; N. ko, obl. kas; B. Or. ke; OAw. lakh. ko; H. obl. kis; OG. inst. kīṇaiṁ, G. ko 'anyone'; M. obl. kaśā < OM. kāsayā (-yā added from nominal declension LM 209); Si. kavda, obl. kā;- < kata-má- (q.v.): Tir. kāmu, Tor. kām, Mai. kā̃, K. kash. kō̃, obl. kas, rām. pog. ḍoḍ. kam, obl. kas.
    kaḥ punar, káścid, kím, kṓ jānāti, kō'paraḥ, kō'pi.
    ka-³ pejorative prefix. [Cf. kā-, ku-, kad-, kím]
    *kadaṇḍa-, *kadugdha-, *karkṣī-, *kastambha-, kāgni-, *kāṅga-, *kāṅgārikā-, *kāpaṇa-, *kaiḍikā-, kōṣma-.
    Addenda: ká-². 1. WPah.kc. ka 'what? why? any', kṭg. kε, J. kā; Garh. ko 'who?'; — Pk. gen. kissa: OA. kisa, kiha, A. kiya 'why?' AFD 224.
    2. kásmāt Add. 14374.

13760.html:
13760 sthā́man n. 'station, place' RV., 'strength' Bālar. [√sthā]
    Pa. thāma- n. 'steadfastness'; Pk. thāma- n. 'place, strength'; S. thāũ m. 'station, place', L. thā̃ m.; P. thā̃, ṭhā̃ f. 'place, room', ludh. ṭhaũ f.; WPah.bhad. ṭhāu n. 'hamlet', pāḍ. ṭhāō, bhal. thεũ f. 'lowest level portion of a house'; N. ṭhāũ 'place', A. ṭhāw, B. ṭhā̃i (< nom. sg. *ṭhāmē ODBL 741); Or. thāā̃ 'place, place for eating in', ṭhāĩ 'place, direction'; Bi. ṭhā̃w 'place'; Mth. ṭhā̃w 'ground smoothed for eating on'; Bhoj. ṭhā̃w, ṭhā̃ī˜ 'place', OAw. ṭhāuṁ f.; H. ṭhā̃w, ṭhāw m.f., ṭhā̃ī˜ f. 'place, situation, residence'; G. ṭhām n. 'place'; OM. thāṁva m. 'strength, bottom', M. ṭhāv m. 'place, free space'; — obl. cases as adv. and postp. (or < sthā́na- ?): L. thãõ 'from'; P. thāũ 'instead of'; WPah.bhal. ṭhεie 'in place of', rudh. thã 'from'; Ku. thaĩ 'near, from, by, with'; N. thāĩ 'near, to'; Or. ṭhāĩ 'in'. — With pronominal elements: Or. eiṭhāĩ, °ṭhĩ 'here', eiṭhaü̃, °ṭhũ, °ṭhu 'from here'; H. kethā̃, °thāī˜ 'where?'; OMarw. jaïṭha, jẽṭhaï 'where'. — See sthāya-.
    *sthāmya-; *āsthāman-, *ut-sthāmayati.
    Addenda: sthā́man-: P. thauh m. 'place, estimate', WPah.kiũth. ṭheũ 'thing', kṭg. (kc.) ṭhéu m. 'knowledge' (Him.I 82 compares stabhitá-, stabhūyánt- RV., — but cf. P. ṭhaur < sthāvará-, WPah.bhal. thεũ < sthā́man-); poet. ṭhae f. 'story, mention'; A. thāi (phonet. thãi, thai) 'spot', thā̃wa (phonet. thãwɔ) 'place' AFD 204; — WPah.kṭg. tháɔ m. 'buttocks', thái f. 'thigh', Wkc. thau m. 'thigh, buttocks' (cf. OM. thāṁva m. 'bottom' < sthā́man-, G. thāpɔ < †sthāpya-).
